jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618654

**Location:** Huntsville, AL, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-30

**Category:** Software

**Subcategory:** SW Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** No

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Interim\_Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Secret

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

SAIC is seeking an experienced **Software Engineer** to support the design, development, and integration of embedded software systems. The selected candidate will work across the software development lifecycle, contributing to architecture development, requirements management, system analysis, design reviews, and software implementation in support of mission-critical programs in **Huntsville, AL.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

The Software Developer will perform a broad range of engineering activities, independently or under general supervision, supporting the design, development, integration, and implementation of software systems and related technologies.

**Job Description**

Key responsibilities include:

* Developing system and software architectures for embedded systems.
* Managing and analyzing software requirements.
* Designing, developing, and implementing embedded software solutions.
* Reviewing system and subsystem specifications, interface documentation, and design artifacts for completeness, accuracy, and applicability.
* Supporting system and subsystem design activities, trade studies, and performance analyses.
* Interpreting and analyzing customer requirements.
* Reviewing, verifying, and validating system specifications and other technical documentation.
* Participating in hardware and software design reviews, technical interchange meetings, management reviews, and configuration control boards.

**Qualifications**

**Education Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline and five (5) years of relevant professional experience; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree (per contract vehicle).

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Must have the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance
* Active Secret clearance preferred
* US Citizenship required

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience developing software in C++ within an embedded environment.
* Proficiency in object-oriented analysis and design using Unified Modeling Language (UML).
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, documentation standards, and CMMI methodologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with VxWorks.
* Experience using IBM Rhapsody.
* Experience using IBM DOORS.

Target salary range: $100,001 - $140,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

* Experience with system integration, test (including EMC), risk assessment, and defect/Deficiency Report adjudication

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer V
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

We are looking for an experienced and creative Electronics Engineering Senior Staff engineer to join an exciting and dynamic team in designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting complex next generation electrical equipment for Missile Defense applications.

**Location:** This position does not support teleworking. You will need to live near our Lockheed Martin Space facility in either Huntsville, AL or Sunnyvale, CA and be expected to work a flexible 9x80 schedule in the office full-time.

**What does this role look like?**

The Missile Defense industry is experiencing significant growth, and we need your expertise to deliver amazing new technologies to our customers. This Electronics Engineering Senior Staff position supports a brand new enterprise wide concept development organization called the Missile Advanced Capability Engineering (MACE) team. Their charter is to develop solutions and concepts for the future of Missile Defense applications aimed at addressing the next generation of evolving threats. You will support Missile Avionics and Electronics design from initial architecture through to concept development and initial build and test while working with a dynamic cross functional team of engineers who support a wide array of next generation development within our Advanced Programs portfolio. This role blends electronics architecture and electrical‑hardware design in a fast‑paced, mission‑oriented environment.

**Key activities you will accomplish in this role:**

* Provide Avionics and Electrical system architecture development
* Design/Capture electrical schematics and guide the board layouts.
* Perform electrical Worst Case Analysis and Electrical Parts Stress Analysis.
* Work on a cross-functional team in the development and integration of world class avionics systems.
* Resolve test anomalies and troubleshooting, and generation, review and presentation of Product Certification, and also support system level testing.

**To be effective in this role, you will need:**

* Experience supporting the technical evaluation of design and requirements verification.
* Experience in different phases of aerospace hardware development cycle, particularly early architecture and concept development
* 9+ years professional experience.
* Must have an active DoD Secret clearance, thus you are a US Citizen.

Manages the research, design, development, and testing of a variety of electronic equipment and systems, including radar and radiation detection equipment; radio, television and other communications equipment and systems; circuitry components; analog and digital computers; and control and test equipment. Responsible for coordinating subordinate employee recruitment, selection and training, performance assessment, work assignments, salary, and recognition/disciplinary actions.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Strong understanding of Aerospace Avionics Architecture along with electronic circuit design principles, including analog and digital circuits.

* Prior technical lead or product technical ownership experience (e.g. Certified Principal Engineer (CPE), Responsible Systems Engineer (RSE)).

  

* Experience with design and concept development of high-reliability electronics or electromechanical systems.

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Technical experience in full life cycle development of complex Electronics hardware including design, integration and test
* Demonstrated experience with design, test, production, and/or analysis of Guidance, Navigation, and/or Control (GNC) hardware and Avionics systems.
* Experience conducting failure analysis on Electronics (system, package, CCA, and piece part level)
* Experience with common environmental and performance test methods (e.g. thermal, vibration, shock, EMI/EMC) for high reliability applications (e.g. missile, launch vehicle, or satellite programs).
* Experience with electronic system design, integration, production, or verification for automotive, missile, launch vehicle, and/or satellite programs.
* Excellent communication and technical writing skills.

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $129000.00 - $239600.00

jobs.title: RF Payload Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About us:

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What you'll do:

The Strategic Space Systems (S3) team at Viasat in Tempe, Arizona is responsible for development of full lifecycle space programs with varying scope, from chip scale to full-on space missions. Our programs provide key capabilities for the US government as well as commercial end-users.

Programs in the business area are far-reaching and impactful - enabling the US and the world in commercial and defense applications like resilient space communications and networking, remote sensing, and much more. The S3 team is primarily composed of a small group of highly skilled cross-domain engineers who take on meaningful problems daily.

The day-to-day:

This position provides an outstanding opportunity to develop innovative technologies. You will work closely with customers to build multi-function systems from concept to implementation. These systems support our nation's most critical defense programs. This includes requirements development, architecture design, integration, and implementation of hardware.

In this exciting and dynamic role, you will report into the S3 organization and work collaboratively with other Viasat partners. Together, you will identify, pursue, capture, and complete high priority opportunities that support our strategic growth goals.

This position is based in Tempe, AZ

What you'll need:

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or related discipline
* 8+ years' experience as an RF/Systems Engineer, including hands-on design, troubleshooting, integration, and test of RF hardware at the PWA, module, unit, and system level
* Demonstrated experience taking RF hardware from design through fabrication, assembly, integration, and verification (bring-up, debug, ATP/qualification testing)
* Experience with RF payload integration and test campaigns (unit-level through spacecraft/system-level I&T)
* Bench-level RF test experience using network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and noise figure/power meters to isolate and resolve hardware issues
* Working knowledge of RF circuit-level design and construction (amplifiers, filters, mixers, switches, interconnects) sufficient to understand how module/unit-level hardware choices drive system performance, cost, and schedule trades
* Experience diagnosing and root-causing RF hardware failures (e.g., via failure analysis, root cause corrective action processes)
* Familiarity with space-qualified RF hardware build standards
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams including Business Development, Systems, Software, RF circuit design, FPGA/digital design, mechanical, and manufacturing/production
* Experience in payload and electronics design for space applications, including reliability, parts/materials/processes (EEE parts), and EMI/EMC requirements for space-based systems
* Strong analytic/mathematics background with experience in system modeling, simulation, and analysis, including power and communication link budgets
* Strong understanding of systems engineering analysis: requirements definition and flow-down, interface definitions, system test design and execution, and risk identification, tracking, and burn-down
* Proficiency using RF and systems design engineering tools including MATLAB, ADS, HFSS, and Genesys
* Ability to serve as the technical RF interface to customers, translating RF hardware capability, constraints, and test results into system-level solutions and trade discussions
* Experience working directly with Government customers to develop system-level requirements and solutions
* Strong technical leadership, including mentoring engineers on hardware integration and test practices

What will help you on the job:

* Masters Degree preferred but not required
* Understanding of model-based system engineering techniques including proficiency using MBSE software such as Cameo
* Experience with satellite missions operations including launch, in-orbit testing, and anomaly resolution
* Experience with key mission design and analysis tools such as STK
* Experience taking a product from concept phase through prototyping, launch, and operation
* Demonstrated leadership of space systems engineering teams
* The ability to lead trade studies and architect innovative solutions to difficult technical problems

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer II
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders, focusing on long-term solutions for the growing aging population.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Firmware Engineer II who is passionate about developing and testing embedded software for medical devices. You'll contribute to the design, implementation, and testing of firmware for our implantable neural interfaces and external devices, working across the embedded software development lifecycle—from hardware bring-up and device drivers to application development, integration, and verification.

This is a hands-on engineering role combining strong technical skills with exceptional attention to detail. You'll work closely with hardware, software, and research teams to build robust embedded systems that meet the demanding requirements of regulated medical devices.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Embedded Firmware Development*

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C++ for implantable and external medical devices.
* Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, and application-level firmware for microcontroller-based systems.
* Implement firmware features involving hardware peripherals, real-time operation, custom ASICs, and communication protocols.
* Develop Python scripts and applications to interface with embedded devices for testing, debugging, and characterization.
* Participate in firmware design discussions and code reviews, contributing to software quality, reliability, and maintainability.

*Hardware Integration & Testing*

* Support hardware bring-up, firmware integration, and troubleshooting of embedded systems.
* Debug hardware and firmware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other laboratory equipment.
* Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to verify firmware functionality and reliability.
* Collaborate with hardware, software, and research teams to integrate firmware with the broader medical-device system.

*Regulated Development & Documentation*

* Develop firmware within our regulated quality management system and software lifecycle, contributing to requirements, design, verification, and documentation consistent with ISO 13485 and IEC 62304.
* Document firmware designs, interfaces, test procedures, and verification results to support development and regulatory activities.
* Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve firmware quality and reliability.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of professional experience developing embedded firmware or embedded software.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ for microcontroller-based embedded systems.
* Experience with microcontrollers (e.g., ARM Cortex-M), hardware peripherals, interrupts, and embedded communication protocols such as UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or embedded device testing.
* Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers.
* Ability to read schematics and understand basic digital and analog electronics.
* Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded software design principles.
* Experience using Git and participating in collaborative software development.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to independently develop, debug, and test firmware features and collaborate across engineering disciplines.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with Nordic Semiconductor nRF microcontrollers, the nRF Connect SDK, and Zephyr RTOS.
* Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), USB, or other embedded communication interfaces.
* Experience developing low-power, battery-operated embedded systems.
* Experience with automated firmware testing, unit testing frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with static code analysis tools and embedded debugging tools such as Segger J-Link or GDB.
* Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated or safety-critical systems.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, or medical-device design controls.
* Familiarity with secure firmware development and medical-device cybersecurity requirements.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

* Ability to work on site, including hands-on testing with prototype devices, laboratory equipment, and participation in hardware bring-up and integration sessions.

**How We Work**
---------------

* **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time.
* **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another.
* **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives.
* **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right.

**Location**
------------

This role is based in Alameda, CA, on site 5 days a week.

**Benefits**
------------

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits:

* Competitive base salary with equity
* 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents
* Generous vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs

Compensation Range: $115K - $140K

An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

  

Are you ready to be part of an inclusive team that’s driving the future of technology? As a Tegra System Software Engineer at NVIDIA, you will play a pivotal role in crafting the next generation of computing. Our team is dedicated to developing world-class systems and solutions that power everything from AI to self-driving cars. Join us in Santa Clara, CA, USA, and contribute to projects that are as ambitious as they are impactful. Your work will help us continue our legacy of flawless innovation and outstanding performance.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Designing, crafting and developing system software relevant to ARM's Trusted Firmware Stack.
* Build and improve agentic workflows for trusted firmware engineering, spanning tasks such as codebase exploration, change planning, implementation support, bring-up, debugging, test execution, and documentation.
* Create reusable workflow components, tools, or skills that connect AI assistants to approved engineering context and systems, such as source repositories, technical documentation, issue trackers, build environments, and test infrastructure.
* Define clear validation and review steps for AI-assisted work. Evaluate generated changes and results for correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability before they are integrated.
* Work across firmware and system software interfaces, including early boot, EL3 runtime services, power management, operating system and hypervisors.
* Involving in sophisticated and next generation CPU architecture that drives our Tegra platform.
* Work with upstream community to develop software for latest ARM technologies such as Confidential Compute and help drive improvements to various specs such as PSCI, FFA, RMI.
Participate in architectural explorations which include feasibility studies, safety evaluations and CPU performance analysis.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of proven experience in system software development.
* Strong software engineering experience in C or C++ and the ability to debug low-level software.
* Experience developing or integrating firmware, embedded software, kernel-level software, or other hardware-adjacent system software.
* Deep understanding of operating system fundamentals and computer architecture concepts such as MMU, Cache Coherency, TLB, Timers, ISRs is a must.
* Knowledge in Safety and Security standards such as ISO26262, CERT-C and MISRA-C would be a plus.
* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools for software engineering tasks such as firmware debugging, regression triage, log analysis, test generation and technical research.
Experience building AI agents or engineering assistants using retrieval-augmented generation, tool use or function calling, agent skills, or multi-step orchestration is a plus.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

We are a well-funded, early-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026.

Our team currently consists of 25 world-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting-edge multimodal research into scalable, real-world systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real-world production deployments. This is an engineering-first, high-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end-to-end applications powered by Glimpse.

You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high-performance systems and feed real-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* **Architect & Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high-throughput workflows.
* **Develop Reference Systems & Tooling:** Create open-source reference implementations, production-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse.
* **Build Evaluation & Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real-world visual datasets.
* **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic.
* **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof-of-concept development, and deployment to production.
* **Influence Model & Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **Strong Core Engineering:** 5+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions.
* **Hands-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision-language models.
* **Model Understanding & Evaluation:** Hands-on experience evaluating, fine-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data-quality issues.
* **Full-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward-deployed engineer is highly valued.
* **Systems & Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints.
* **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders.

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company.
* Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production).
* Experience developing public developer APIs, open-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems.

**Logistics**
-------------

* **Location:** On-site in Palo Alto, CA
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 + significant equity + comprehensive health insurance and perks

jobs.description:
### **About Tutor**

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

### **The Role**

We are looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to lead the design and implementation of core software systems across our stack. This role is less about writing isolated features and more about owning architecture, setting technical direction, and building scalable, reliable platforms that support machine learning, robotics, and operations at scale.

You will work across backend services, data and ML infrastructure, internal tools, and customer-facing systems, while collaborating closely with robotics, hardware, and operations teams. Robotics is part of the domain, but this role is primarily about building high-leverage software systems that make the entire company faster and more effective.

### **Requirements**

* Strong programming ability and experience building large, production software systems.
* Proven track record of owning and evolving complex systems over time.
* Experience working across backend, infrastructure, and application layers.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and making pragmatic architectural tradeoffs.
* Clear communicator who can lead technical discussions and align teams.

### **Nice to haves (zero or more)**

* Experience with Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.
* Experience with ML platforms, data pipelines, or ML-adjacent infrastructure.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and developer tooling.
* Familiarity with robotics or hardware-integrated systems (not required).
* Startup experience or experience building systems from zero to production.

### **Why Tutor?**

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

### **Benefits**

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Space Systems Engineer, Avionics** oversees the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for our Winnebago Spaceship. They ensure that all systems are ready for both launch and operational phases, requiring a deep understanding of avionics system design, manufacturing processes, and operational protocols. They closely collaborate with various engineering teams and navigate conflicting requirements to achieve seamless system integration. Their expertise will be crucial in ensuring the vehicle meets its mission objectives, from space manufacturing to hypersonic testing during reentry.

* Collaborate with cross functional teams to define project scopes and initial requirements, guiding designs from concept to prototype and full-scale production.
* Develop electrical architecture, system diagrams, and budgets to account for power, telemetry, channel count, size, and mass predictions used to communicate closing vehicle solutions to company level objectives.
* Analyze architecture for potential faults and risks, develop comprehensive mitigation plans, resolve uncertainties, and collaborate on Fault Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) or operational workarounds when hardware solutions are unfeasible.
* Conduct comprehensive verification plans for avionics systems on flight and HITL hardware, ensuring readiness for launch and compliance with mission objectives for space and reentry operations.
* Participate in mission operations as an Avionics specialist or system operator, where they'll determine system health, suggest corrective actions to reentry commit criteria for operational success.
* Oversee the integration of the Winnebago avionics systems, acting as the primary point of contact for integrated systems investigations.
* Design, build, and operate the Hardware In The Loop (HITL) testbeds, simulating the spacecraft on the ground to ensure all systems are mission ready.
* Develop avionics ground infrastructure, support the design and integration of test racks and R&D equipment used to power and communicate with the flight vehicles. Contribute to developing engineering best practices, focusing on increased test automation and efficiency.
* Draw from their experiences to help mentor and train new engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the team.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* Experience: 5+ years of experience in system design, test planning, and validation.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python.
* Technical Expertise: Experience with power supplies, modular DAQ systems, RTD and 4-20mA devices, and general test equipment.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Proven experience taking vehicle electrical systems from concept to operational production.
* Prior experience setting up HITL testbeds, managing configuration control, and conducting system level tests.
* Familiarity with Unix environments and the ability to use command line utilities.
* Experience developing test cases and test equipment to meet vehicle operating conditions.
* Strong project or program management skills.
* Relevant prior roles: Avionics Hardware, FPGA Engineer, Electronics Test Engineer, Electrical Systems Engineer

* This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Anduril Battlespace Awareness Radar team develops state-of-the-art radar systems, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The Radar team is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to transform ambitious concepts into manufacturable reality for the next generation of US radars. The Radar team is responsible for all aspects of radar system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to design high-speed mixed-signal architectures and circuits, manage signal integrity in complex PCBs, and mature prototypes into products.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design combinations of high-speed digital, precision analog, RF, and high-power architectures
* Design embedded electronics from concept to functional prototype, including hardware selection, schematic & PCB design, board bring-up, and system level integration
* Troubleshoot issues that span the electrical and software boundaries, with solid skills using both lab equipment (Oscilloscopes, DMM, etc.) and basic software debugging tools
* Work with modern SoCs and networking hardware to build Anduril platforms
* Work closely with firmware/software engineers for processor/peripheral selection, board bring up, and troubleshooting.
* Work closely with other electrical, mechanical, software, firmware, and test engineers to deliver fully functional products
* Work in a fast-paced environment, having to juggle multiple concurrent projects and customers.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
* 8+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex hardware, embedded systems, and products
* Demonstrated experience with multi-gigabit SERDES, DDR memory busses, Ethernet MAC and PHY interfaces, FPGAs, and common communication busses like SPI and I2C
* Experience with microprocessor and microcontroller selection, configuration, and interfacing
* Experience with component, schematic capture, high speed board design, and guiding PCB layout.
* Competence with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, current-probes, sprectrum/network analyzers, and automation of tests
* Familiarity with product development processes and tools
* Knowledge of embedded software development, including use of timers, interrupts, hardware peripherals such as SPI controllers and ADCs
* Experience with signal integrity and power integrity rules and simulation
* Exceptional organization and communication skills (both written and oral)
* Proficient with Altium Designer or equivalent electronic design tools
* Familiar with common programming languages like Python for test automation.
* Must be eligible to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret Security Clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Familiar with RF design and layout
* Past experience with placement and routing of PCBs
* Experience with JESD204 and PCIe
* Familiarity with military standards (MIL-STD-461/704/1275)
* Experience with high speed ADC/DAC's and software defined radios

Responsibilities:  

* As an Electrical Engineer 1 in our Nuclear Power Group, you will play a vital role on projects that make a real impact. You will help design and modernize critical electrical systems and large power components for existing nuclear plants, first-of-a-kind restart projects, small modular reactors (SMRs), and advanced reactor facilities. You will also support plant life-extension and digital upgrade initiatives. Your contributions will help make nuclear energy safer, more efficient, and more reliable for the communities we serve.
* You will work alongside a project team, receiving daily technical supervision and support from experienced engineers and subject matter experts (SME’s) in nuclear power generation and electrical power systems design. You will benefit from hands-on learning, technical training, and collaboration across engineering disciplines, while leveraging our established system of technical processes — including industry standards, internally developed guidance and standards informed by decades of experience, and our extensive performance improvement database — to help deliver safe and reliable solutions.
* Working under the direction of senior engineers, this position will offer you the opportunity to utilize and expand your academic background in electrical engineering in one or more of the following areas:
  + Assist in the preparation of engineering calculations and design tasks for large nuclear power generating stations, including protection and coordination studies, cable sizing, medium and low voltage system design, DC battery sizing, and analyses that supports electrical designs for safety-related systems.
  + Utilize industry-standard software tools like ETAP to perform power systems analysis and modeling for complex electrical networks.
  + Assist with the design, selection, and integration of major electrical power equipment, such as switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), large power transformers, breakers, relays, and related systems essential to nuclear power generation station operation.
  + Partner with multidisciplinary engineering teams and engage in technical training sessions and reviews.
  + Gain exposure to station-specific procedures and real-world project requirements, with opportunities to interface with client stakeholders such as Operations and Systems Engineering representatives.
  + Collaborate with designers and drafters to translate engineering concepts into detailed drawings, providing practical experience in bringing designs to life and supporting project deliverables.
  + Develop professional skills by working within fixed project schedules and budgets, learning effective time management and collaboration tools to achieve shared objectives. Gain firsthand experience in communicating and coordinating with team members to deliver high-quality engineering solutions on time and within scope.
  + Work alongside experienced professional engineers and gain valuable insight into the pathway to professional licensure, including mentorship and exposure to the career development steps required to become a licensed Professional Engineer (PE).
  + Gain unescorted access to nuclear power generating stations to conduct onsite walkdowns, witness installation and testing activities, and support nuclear refueling outages, as well as participate in the implementation of major projects you helped design.
  + Access client computer systems to review station-specific drawings, calculations, procedures, and other technical information, building expertise in design and licensing basis and electrical power systems for a specific nuclear facility.
  + Obtain qualifications to work under supervision as a preparer for unique engineering deliverables, and have the opportunity to sign off as a qualified preparer on critical project documentation.

Qualifications:

**We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.**

Essential skills and experience:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with a strong academic background in electrical power concepts/power systems analysis
* An understanding of the practical application of electrical engineering and technology including applying systems, principles, techniques, and procedures to a project design
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, drawings, and models
* Proficiency with MS Office applications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills

Valued but not required skills and experience:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s of Science degree from an ABET Engineering Accreditation Commission-approved program
* Completion of power coursework, such as Power Systems Analysis, Electric Machinery, Power Electronics, or similar
* Internship or work experience in performing power analysis, preferably within the power industry
* Experience performing transient analysis of power systems using software such as ETAP or SKM
* Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam, and designation as an Engineer in Training

Technology & Innovation:

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.
  
  
We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.

**Description**

SAIC is seeking a Systems Engineer Associate to join and support our dynamic team in Panama City Beach, Florida.

**This work will be performed on site in Panama City Beach, Florida.**

This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career while supporting multiple Navy projects of varying complexity. We are seeking motivated individuals eager to gain entry-level engineering experience in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional development.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

* Support verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution, including the development of test procedures, test reports, and acceptance criteria for hardware and software components.
* Participate in system-level design reviews and verification/validation activities.
* Work with cross-functional teams across mechanical, electrical, and software subsystems as well as cybersecurity to ensure proper integration and performance of distributed system architectures.
* Identify, assess, and manage project and system risks, including mitigation planning and risk reporting throughout the system lifecycle.
* Provide technical insight to support troubleshooting and resolution of issues during development, production, and fielding phases.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and technical deliverables for internal and external stakeholders.
* Contribute to the review and refinement of technical documents to ensure quality, accuracy, and completeness.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with an ability to balance multiple tasks and competing priorities in dynamic environments
* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Foundational understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements development, functional decomposition, interface definition, and verification and validation
* Exposure to MBSE tools such as Cameo, or Enterprise Architect
* Understanding of risk management principles, including risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and monitoring
* Knowledge of SysML (Systems Modeling Language) for representing system architecture and requirements in MBSE environments
* Knowledge of CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or CREO)
* Familiarity with military specifications, standards, or commercial development best practices
* Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware/software integration concepts, including digital and analog I/O, serial communication buses (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, RS-422/485), and sensor/actuator interfacing
* Experience working in collaborative, team-based environments
* Familiarity with systems concepts such as requirements management, risk management, verification, or validation

**CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT:**

* Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance
* Interim Secret required to start
* SAIC will sponsor qualified candidates for security clearance

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Space is a critical domain, connecting our technologies, our security and our humanity. While others view space as a destination, we see it as a realm of possibilities, where we can do more — we can innovate, invest, inspire and integrate our capabilities to transform the future.  
  
At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We’re creating future-ready solutions, focusing on resiliency and urgency through our 21st Century Security® vision. We’re erasing boundaries and forming partnerships across industries and around the world. We’re advancing spacecraft and the workforce to fuel the next generation. And we’re reimagining how space can connect us, ensuring security and prosperity.  
  
Join us in shaping a new era in space and find a career that's built for you.  
  
The selected candidate will join the Spacemesh Controller team in developing capabilities for the Space Development Agency (SDA). This covers Tranche 2 of the Transport and Tracking Layers as well as Tranche 3 of the Tracking Layer  
  
The SDA's Tranche 2 Beta Transport Layer (T2B) is a mesh network of over one hundred optically interconnected satellites that provides a resilient, low-latency, high-volume data transport communication system. The SDA's Tranche 2 and Tranche 3 Tracking Layers (T2TK/TRKT3) build upon the Transport Layer to transport high-fidelity mission payload data. Delivering persistent, encrypted tracking and battlespace awareness, the layer enables global sensor fusion and Warfighter mission support around the globe.  
  
We're looking for a highly motivated and experienced software engineer to join our fast-paced development effort and contribute to the success of a very challenging and rewarding mission.  
  
The successful candidate will have a commendable work ethic, good communication skills, a great attitude, be a results-oriented team player, creative thinker and problem-solver, and follow all ethical standards of the Lockheed Martin Corporation.  
  
The responsibilities include supporting software design, development, and verification activities using the best software development practices as well as supporting critical test preparation and events that will occur in the Rockville, MD and eventually Bethesda, MD facilities.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Software development experience and proficiency in C++, Linux, and Python
* Currently holds a US government Security clearance of Secret or higher

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience in requirements definitions
* Familiar with network protocols, packets forwarding concepts
* Familiar with Interface Control Document (ICD) definitions
* Experience in developing software in satellite communication domain and a good understanding of the related software architecture
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

jobs.description:
**Field Service & Electrical Engineer**

Steelhead, Inc. | San Antonio, TX

**Compensation:** $90,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience  
Travel: 30–50% | Employment: Full-time

Love troubleshooting machinery? Enjoy electrical design? We should talk.

Steelhead, Inc. designs and manufactures automated water bottling and water treatment equipment for customers throughout North America and internationally.

We’re looking for a hands-on Electrical Engineer who enjoys solving problems, working with industrial machinery, and seeing equipment come to life.

This isn’t a position where you’ll spend every day behind a desk. You’ll split your time between designing and improving electrical systems at our San Antonio facility and traveling to customer sites to install, commission, and troubleshoot equipment.

We’re especially interested in someone who is naturally curious, enjoys technical challenges, and takes pride in getting complicated machinery running properly.

**What You’ll Do**

Field Service & Troubleshooting

* Install, commission, and troubleshoot automated bottling and water treatment equipment.
* Diagnose electrical, controls, instrumentation, and electromechanical problems.
* Troubleshoot motors, VFDs, sensors, valves, pumps, and industrial control systems.
* Work directly with customers to resolve technical issues, both remotely and on-site.
* Support equipment startup, testing, and operator training.
* Travel approximately 30–50%, primarily throughout North America.

Electrical Engineering & Controls

* Design electrical control systems for new and existing equipment.
* Develop and modify electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts.
* Select electrical components, instrumentation, and automation hardware.
* Support PLC/HMI troubleshooting and system improvements.
* Assist with PLC programming and modifications based on experience.
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers, production technicians, and field service personnel to improve equipment reliability and performance.

Water Treatment Technology

* Learn the fundamentals of reverse osmosis, filtration, ozone, UV disinfection, and industrial water treatment.
* Support troubleshooting and improvement of water treatment equipment.
* Assist with developing equipment operating sequences and controls narratives.
* Develop an understanding of how electrical controls, instrumentation, and water treatment processes work together.

*Prior water treatment experience is not required. We’re looking for someone interested in learning.*

**What We’re Looking Fo**r

Required Qualifications

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or equivalent hands-on industrial automation experience.
* Experience with industrial electrical systems and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics.
* Working knowledge of industrial control panels, motors, sensors, VFDs, and instrumentation.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working independently with customers and equipment in the field.
* Willingness to travel 30–50%.
* Strong communication skills and a customer-focused attitude.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Siemens or Allen-Bradley PLCs.
* PLC/HMI programming or troubleshooting experience.
* AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical design software.
* Experience with industrial automation, packaging equipment, or process machinery.
* Familiarity with pumps, valves, fluid handling, or water treatment equipment.
* Experience developing equipment operating sequences or controls narratives.

The Right Personality Matters

The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Genuinely enjoys troubleshooting and figuring out how things work.
* Likes working with both their hands and their head.
* Is comfortable moving between engineering design and the manufacturing floor.
* Enjoys traveling, meeting customers, and solving real-world equipment problems.
* Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they’re resolved.
* Is curious about new technologies and willing to learn.

**Why Steelhead?**

Steelhead offers the opportunity to work on complete industrial systems rather than just one small part of a machine.

You’ll be involved in electrical design, manufacturing, equipment testing, customer installations, and ongoing improvements. You’ll work directly with an experienced engineering and technical team while developing expertise in industrial automation and water treatment technology.

If you’re an electrical engineer who loves troubleshooting machinery and wants a position with variety, responsibility, and hands-on challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

To apply: Submit your resume and a brief description of the types of industrial equipment and control systems you’ve worked with.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan

Location:

* San Antonio, TX 78221 (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

We put our people first, embrace a family culture, and make sure innovative ideas are heard. Join a team where your expertise is valued and your work makes a meaningful impact on critical missions.
  
Position Overview
  
Fusion Innovation is seeking an Expert RF Systems Engineer to serve as a senior technical advisor for wireless communication systems. This role develops, validates, and optimizes RF link budgets, translates system requirements into quantitative performance models, and provides recommendations that inform architecture, design, deployment, and operational decisions. You will collaborate with RF, antenna, systems, network, hardware, software, and field engineering teams to meet coverage, capacity, availability, reliability, and performance objectives.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Develop comprehensive uplink and downlink RF link budgets for terrestrial, satellite, cellular, private wireless, tactical, or other wireless communication systems.
  
Calculate and validate transmit power and EIRP; receiver sensitivity; antenna gain; cable, connector, feeder, and implementation losses; free-space path loss; atmospheric and environmental losses; fading, shadowing, and polarization losses.
  
Analyze noise figure, system noise temperature, thermal noise, noise bandwidth, receiver G/T where applicable, carrier-to-noise ratio (C/N), carrier-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (C/(I+N)), Eb/N₀, and required versus available link margin.
  
Model performance across frequency bands, modulation schemes, bandwidths, antenna configurations, propagation environments, and operating conditions.
  
Perform best-case, nominal, worst-case, and statistical analyses; establish engineering margins aligned with availability and reliability requirements.
  
Identify link-margin limitations, assess propagation and interference impacts, and determine the parameters with the greatest influence on system performance.
  
Conduct trade studies involving transmit power, antenna gain, receiver performance, bandwidth, coding and modulation, frequency selection, and deployment configuration.
  
Independently review and validate complex RF analyses and communicate recommendations to multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  
,
  
Required Skills
  
  
Active Top Secret/SCI with Polygraph.
  
Minimum of 12 years of experience with a BS/BA, 10 years with an MS/MA, or 7 years with a PhD. An additional four years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  
Demonstrated expert-level experience developing and reviewing RF link budgets and performing quantitative RF trade studies and sensitivity analyses.
  
Strong understanding of RF propagation, antennas, transmission lines, receivers, transmitters, and wireless communication systems.
  
Expertise in RF power and gain/loss calculations; dB/dBm/dBW conversions; noise figure and temperature; receiver sensitivity; C/N, C/I, C/(N+I), and Eb/N₀; free-space and non-free-space path loss; fade and implementation margins; antenna gain, beamwidth, polarization, and pointing; and modulation and coding impacts.
  
Ability to independently validate complex engineering analyses, with strong technical writing, presentation, and communication skills.
  
,
  
Desired Skills
  
  
Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
  
Experience with 4G/5G, private LTE/5G, satellite, microwave, tactical communications, or other advanced wireless systems.
  
Experience with RF propagation and coverage modeling tools and software such as MATLAB/Simulink, Python, STK, ADS, HFSS, CST, Atoll, or Pathloss.
  
Experience using spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, power meters, and related RF test equipment.
  
Knowledge of antenna system design and characterization, and experience analyzing link availability and reliability.
  
Familiarity with applicable IEEE, ITU, 3GPP, FCC, or other relevant RF and wireless standards and regulations.
  
Experience supporting field deployment, drive testing, RF acceptance testing, or system verification.
  
Experience leading technical teams or serving as a senior engineering consultant or advisor.
  
,

Fusion Innovation anticipates the annual base salary for this position will generally range from $100,000 to $215,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to:
  
Relevant education, certifications, and training

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.  

* Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
* Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
* Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.  

* Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
* Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
* Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
* Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
* Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
* Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who lives and breathes Azure Cosmos DB and knows how it is implemented underneath. Your mission is to make throttling disappear from Microsoft's AI plugin registry with fast, surgical, high-ROI changes. Success is objective: throttling goes away, reliability goes up, and latency goes down, even as scale grows. You will see the results in days, not quarters.

We are the Agent Tools and Lifecycle team in Microsoft's Copilot, Agents and Platform (CAP) organization. We build the service behind the AI plugin registry. Admins use it in the Microsoft 365 admin center to govern the plugins (skills, connectors, and agents) that extend Microsoft Copilot, and users discover and use those plugins across products such as Copilot Chat, Cowork, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The registry is a core part of Microsoft's AI architecture, alongside Work IQ, and Copilot experiences across Microsoft depend on it. If you use an AI solution from Microsoft, you likely are working with our service. Come join us at the center of AI transformation at Microsoft!

As a hands-on individual contributor, you will be the technical leader for the AI plugin registry's Azure Cosmos DB tier. Our catalog of plugins and agents, and the entitlements and policies that decide who can use them, live in Cosmos DB in data centers worldwide, including sovereign clouds. Traffic keeps growing as the registry expands to experiences such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry. Experience working on the internals of Cosmos DB or a comparable database, such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, and an understanding of the hardware and network limits that make them throttle, are especially valuable. Our global reach means 24/7 on-call service.

This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Cut request unit (RU) consumption to make throttling go away, fast. Start with the queries that use the most RUs, where we see room for 50–90% reductions: turn cross-partition and fan-out queries into point reads from Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage, batched reads, or single-partition queries, and tune indexes.
* Pick work by return on investment. Ship several targeted fixes in parallel, each within days, and measure each one in production. Take on a larger redesign only when the data shows smaller fixes cannot get there, and deliver it in steps that each pay off.
* Fix hot partitions and size limits at the source: partition keys, document design, indexing policies, and API contracts that give high-traffic calls the keys they need for point reads. When data has to move, migrate it with zero downtime across all environments, including sovereign clouds.
* Decide what belongs in Cosmos DB. Move large, binary, unbounded, or rarely queried content to Azure Blob Storage or other storage, weighing latency, availability, and data-residency needs.
* Remove redundant and sequential database calls on our busiest paths with batching, request coalescing, and caching, and use retry budgets, load shedding, and graceful degradation so database pressure does not turn into failed requests.
* Work with product management and the teams that call us to give each caller a throttling budget. Find callers that request the same unchanged data again and again, help them cache on their side, and lower the budgets of the heaviest callers over time.
* Make success measurable: own the telemetry, dashboards, and alerts, RU use per API and per caller, partition skew, availability, and latency. Set targets, show the effect of every change, and spot limits before we hit them.
* Raise the bar through AI: write AI skills that review designs and code for Cosmos DB mistakes, find high-RU queries, and show engineers how to fix them, so your expertise scales across the team. Use agentic tools to build and validate fixes faster, following Responsible AI practices. Mentor engineers and represent us with the Azure Cosmos DB product group.
* Serve as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) in our 24/7 on-call rotation, lead data-tier incident response, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

 **Qualifications**  

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience building or operating large-scale distributed databases, such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, including partitionin
